text_block_list.text:
(I can't believe it's already the last day
of summer
camp. Feels like it went by in
a flash.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: (But... I definitely did improve.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Don't come crying to me if people scoff
at you
when you ask them to train with a
pipsqueak.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: No one would do that.
No one would do that.

The Kikuka Sho, huh? I guess I should
give it a
shot.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Hm? Who's that in front of the screen?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан is in the lead with fifty
meters left!
She's holding it... and
finishes first!
text_block_list.name: Screen

text_block_list.text:
That was nine lengths between first and
second
place! Нарита Брайан debuts with a
glorious win!
text_block_list.name: Screen

text_block_list.text: Brian's debuted already?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello, Taishin. Yes, she'll be in her
junior year
starting this year.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан is an Umamusume with
devastating
physical prowess—hailed as
"the Beast"—and is
also Бива Хаяхидэ's
younger sister.

I'm guessing you're not watching this
footage
over and over again just
because you're proud of
your sister.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Hehe... How nice it would be if our
relationship
were that simple.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The Beast has been loosed from her
cage now. I'm
sure she'll sweep through
all her races and sprint
toward a glorious
level of fame.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I dare even say that it won't be long
until she
sinks her teeth into me as well.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Hayahide...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: However, I will not let her tear me apart.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
My winning equation will be completed
soon.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: (The heck is up with that...)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(It's not something you get just by
training!)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Summer camp comes to a conclusion,
and the
Kikuka Sho draws near, bringing
with it
premonitions of trouble.
Cough, cough!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Ugh... I keep coughing lately...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
